article.title: Trump preparing for fresh bombing offensive on Iran after the midterms: WSJ
article.summary: President Trump has turned down a proposed pause in fighting withIranand confided to aides that he anticipates striking the country again once this fall's midterm elections have concluded, the Wall Street Journalreported.The rejected offer came out of weekend talks inQatar, where Iranian representatives suggested a seven-day halt to hostilities that would have seen Tehran reopen a critical shipping waterway and resume nuclear discussions, contingent on Washington easing its economic squeeze on the country, including its naval presence blocking Iranian ports. Trump maintains publicly that Iran will ultimately have no choice but to accept a deal once the election passes, but sources say he harbors real doubts Tehran will cooperate and has already signaled to staff that renewed airstrikes feel like the more probable path forward.Just how extensive any future strikes might be is still uncertain.
